sql: SELECT json_build_object('settings', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('enabled', s.is_enabled, 'hours_before', s.hours_before_visit, 'win', s.send_window_start || '-' || s.send_window_end, 'second', s.second_message_enabled, 'msg', left(s.confirmation_message, 300))) FROM visit_confirmation_settings s WHERE s.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'), 'cron', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', j.jobname, 'schedule', j.schedule, 'active', j.active)) FROM cron.job j WHERE j.command ILIKE '%visit-confirmation%'), 'last_runs', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT d.status, d.start_time FROM cron.job_run_details d JOIN cron.job j ON j.jobid = d.jobid WHERE j.command ILIKE '%visit-confirmation%' ORDER BY d.start_time DESC LIMIT 3) x), 'visitas_ia', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', v.id, 'data', v.data_visita, 'hora', v.horario_visita, 'status', v.status_visita, 'lead', v.lead_id, 'conv', (SELECT c.id FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.lead_id = v.lead_id LIMIT 1))) FROM lead_visits v WHERE v.observacoes ILIKE '%pela IA%' AND v.data_visita >= current_date - 7), 'historico_recente', (SELECT count(*) FROM visit_confirmation_history h WHERE h.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND h.created_at > now() - interval '14 days'))
